# stripe_metronome_contract (Resource)

A customer contract provisioned from a package or created directly against a rate card. Destroy archives the contract and can cancel draft invoices or expire balances. Import as customer_id/contract_id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `customer_id` (String)
- `starting_at` (String) RFC 3339 start, aligned to the hour. Equivalent timestamp formatting updates Terraform state without replacing the contract.
- `uniqueness_key` (String) Unique 1–128 character key. Replacements require a new key even after archival.

### Optional

- `ending_before` (String) Exclusive contract end. A new instant uses editContract in place; equivalent timestamp formatting only updates Terraform state. Omitting the field adopts the remote value and does not clear an existing end date; use the explicit editContract action to clear one.
- `name` (String) Name of a direct contract; cannot be set with package_id.
- `package_id` (String) Package to provision from. Set exactly one of package_id or rate_card_id.
- `rate_card_id` (String) Rate card for a direct contract. Set exactly one of package_id or rate_card_id.
- `void_invoices_on_destroy` (Boolean) Whether contract archival voids finalized invoices. False preserves finalized invoices, but archive still affects draft invoices and prepaid balances.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
